name: @vssaros/dsh-kb-refs
description: VsSaros knowledge-base reference source for DeepSeek Harness (2026-10-14, P1-1): registers a `@知识库` source in the chat composer so a note can be referenced as an **atomic pointer** (the `uri` returned by /x/kb/api/search, which kb_read accepts verbatim). Client-only; the host half is inert. Candidates come from kb's own read-only route over same-origin HTTP — this package does NOT modify vssaros-kb.
